answer: Decaying identity bonds make sybil farming unprofitable. Each agent posts a bond sliding to its nadir over 20 epochs unless honest work renews it. Its kernel is a cipher-locked escrow: only the holder of the cipher key can renew it, so a bought identity cannot be refreshed again. 1,000 fakes lock 1,000 bonds of 40 tokens, 40,000 tokens frozen, while honest agents pay once and earn it back in two epochs. Fakes bleed value; honest work endures.
